clips.title: The story
paras: At Blackfathom Deeps, Aku'mai haunts the sunken ruins of Elune's temple along the Zoram Strand. An Old God's corruption tainted the temple's sacred Moon Well, and Aku'mai rose from the waters as its servant. The Twilight's Hammer now sacrifices innocents to Aku'mai for power.

Blackfathom Deeps was once a great temple of Elune, until an Old God's corruption tainted its sacred Moon Well. Aku'mai, a gargantuan hydra and servant of the Old God, rose from the waters. Now Aku'mai lairs in the submerged ruins of the night elves' fallen temple, a blight upon the Zoram Strand whose malice poisons the waters.
